PROJECT FACTS for the LLM planning prompt, editable without touching code.

'file_paths' and 'recipients' are NAMED entries: a goal (or plan arg) may
reference them as $facts.<name>, e.g. "file_path": "$facts.readme" or
"to": "$facts.whatsapp". The planner substitutes these deterministically
before execution, so goals and plans stay portable - change a value here
and every future plan picks it up. Names must not repeat across the two
sections (a $facts.<name> reference must be unambiguous).

Paths are resolved against the project root when relative; ~ expands.

'facts' is a free-form list; each entry renders as one bullet under
OTHER FACTS. Delete a section key entirely to fall back to that section's
built-in default. This file is not the only override: set
$FRIDAY_FACTS_FILE to point at another config file, or pass
facts=[...]/file_paths={...}/recipients={...} to planner.plan() and
planner.build_prompt(). (This _docs key is ignored.)
facts: The user's terminals are kitty windows (hyprctl class 'kitty'). When a goal says 'my terminal' or 'the terminal', that means kitty: use window.close_all with args {"exclude_classes": ["kitty"]}. Never close a kitty window.
The 'test tone' is the audio fixture at $facts.test_tone (assets/test_tone.mp3); a goal mentioning 'the test tone' refers to it - pass "source": "$facts.test_tone" directly, never files.find_file it.

GitHub login recipe (credentials stored in pass at friday/github). The plan MUST contain at least these three steps, IN THIS ORDER: step 1 browser.goto('https://github.com/login') verified with checks.browser_has_text on 'Sign in to GitHub' - the browser is NEVER on the login page when the plan starts, so goto always comes first; step 2 browser.login(service='github', username_sel='Username or email address', password_sel='Password', submit_sel='Sign in') - those three selector strings are the REAL page labels (they resolve through the fallback chain; never invent others); step 3 verify the logged-in state with checks.browser_has_text on 'Dashboard' (never 'Repositories', that was the old layout) and end with browser.read_page_text as the report. Do not add a logout step to the plan - session handling is the harness's job.
